target: Roku home, the classic grid (Roku OS 15, early 2026), 1920x1080
sources: YouTube, Datyell Close, "Undo Roku's new menu layout and get the simple home screen back", https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jA0Zq4vIoK0 (1080p): the classic home at 39-52 s, a flat capture inset in the frame at 1510x850 (scaled x1.2715 to 1920x1080); frames read in the browser, nothing downloaded
Roku developer documentation, Manifest file (https://developer.roku.com/docs/developer-program/getting-started/architecture/channel-manifest.md): the home-screen app icon is 540x405 at FHD (4:3)

measurements.header: a 185-tall band (art: a city skyline, which Plum replaces with a plain gradient); brand and section label from x 87 centred on y 81; options hint and clock at the right, the clock ending x 1864; the focused tile's position as 'n of m' right-aligned to the grid at y 213
measurements.menu: a column of icons (centres x 108, from y 283 on a ~90 pitch) about 210 wide; it widens with labels while focused (the classic layout's text menu)
measurements.grid: three columns of 4:3 tiles 300 x 225 from x 242 on a 324 pitch (24 gaps), from y 249 with rows 249 apart; no labels under app tiles
measurements.focus: a light lavender ring (#b7afd2) about 6 px thick, 12-18 px outside the tile, no scaling; it moves at once
measurements.right panel: a featured panel 547 wide from x 1325, y 250 to 1009, dark (#1b1e34) with a light edge; Plum shows the focused item there instead
measurements.colours: field and menu #131e67, header band violet to magenta
measurements.motion: the source segment holds still (no grid scroll), so only the instant focus frame is checked
